lines.speaker: PER-CONTI
lines.text: Good morning everyone, let's start, we have four items today.

lines.speaker: PER-COSTA
lines.text: Beinasco ran at ninety-two percent output last week, no line stops.

lines.speaker: PER-GALLO
lines.text: The 8D on the HB-620 porosity is closed, the Pellice castings look clean since October.

lines.speaker: PER-FERRI
lines.text: Bormida is two weeks late. Let's take the BR-220 blanks from Chisone, same alloy.

lines.speaker: PER-ROMANO
lines.text: Last spring Dora moved the HB-620 casting to their second cell, and that went through PPAP fine.

lines.speaker: PER-FERRI
lines.text: If Bormida slips again next quarter we might look at a second source for BR-225, but not today.

lines.speaker: PER-CONTI
lines.text: Thanks for joining, quick follow-up on the BR-220 supply.

lines.speaker: PER-ROSSI
lines.text: We re-audited Chisone last week, they passed with a score of 86.

lines.speaker: PER-COSTA
lines.text: We can run eight days on stock at Beinasco.

lines.speaker: PER-ROMANO
lines.text: Can we switch BR-220 from anodising to trivalent conversion coating?

lines.speaker: PER-GALLO
lines.text: Aurelia's resident engineer asked for the updated BR-220 control plan by Friday.

lines.speaker: PER-ROSSI
lines.text: Let's move the BR-220 final inspection to the new CMM next week.

lines.speaker: PER-FERRI
lines.text: Fonderia Valchiusella sent us a good quote, let's buy the HB-620 castings from them instead of Pellice.

lines.speaker: PER-CONTI
lines.text: Good, I'll bring these to the decision with the cards. Thanks everyone.
